Convert coordinate columns from degree decimal minutes to decimal degrees

Source: R/ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd.R
ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd.Rd

Finds every column in dat whose name ends in _n_ddm, _s_ddm, _e_ddm or _w_ddm (e.g., deployment_latitude_n_ddm, retrieval_longitude_w_ddm) and converts it to decimal degrees.

The sign comes from the hemisphere letter in the column name: _s_ and _w_ columns are returned as negative values; _n_ and _e_ columns as positive values.

The result goes in a column with the hemisphere and _ddm removed (deployment_latitude_n_ddm becomes deployment_latitude). If that column already exists, only its NA values are filled in, so coordinates already recorded in decimal degrees are kept.

Usage

ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd(dat, keep_ddm = TRUE)

Arguments

dat

Data frame with at least one *_n_ddm, *_s_ddm, *_e_ddm or *_w_ddm column. Values must be in the form "degrees decimal-minutes", e.g., "45 21.651" or "64 2.063".

keep_ddm

Logical argument indicating whether to keep the *_ddm columns. Default is TRUE.

Value

Returns dat with the decimal-degree columns added or filled in.

Examples

dat <- data.frame(
  station = c("Borgles Island", "Birchy Head"),
  deployment_latitude_n_ddm = c("44 46.345", "44 34.206"),
  deployment_longitude_w_ddm = c("62 43.565", "64 2.063")
)

ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd(dat)
#>          station deployment_latitude_n_ddm deployment_longitude_w_ddm
#> 1 Borgles Island                 44 46.345                  62 43.565
#> 2    Birchy Head                 44 34.206                   64 2.063
#>   deployment_latitude deployment_longitude
#> 1            44.77242            -62.72608
#> 2            44.57010            -64.03438

# existing decimal-degree values are kept; only the NA values are filled in
dat$deployment_latitude <- c(44.77241, NA)
ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd(dat, keep_ddm = FALSE)
#>          station deployment_latitude deployment_longitude
#> 1 Borgles Island            44.77241            -62.72608
#> 2    Birchy Head            44.57010            -64.03438
